note: RFC 6793 §4.1 states: 'The new attributes, AS4_PATH and AS4_AGGREGATOR, MUST NOT be carried in an UPDATE message between NEW BGP speakers.' Section 6 repeats the prohibition. Re-read both primary passages, summary and unannotated checklist row, all five tagged covers and actual producers. TestOriginatedUpdateOmitsAS4PathTowardNewSpeaker drives the seven enumerated AS_PATH builder entry points with a non-mappable AS, asserting no decoded AS4_PATH AS numbers and the exact four-octet AS_PATH; TestOriginatedAggregatorOmitsAS4AggregatorTowardNewSpeaker drives all four enumerated aggregator builders, asserting attribute-18 absence and the real non-mappable AS in AGGREGATOR. The actual origination gates are UpdateBuilder.appendASPath/ASPathNeedsAS4 and appendAggregator/AS4AggregatorFor. The two NEW-speaker CI carriers supply the forbidden attributes rather than merely observing their absence on clean input: no-as4path requires exactly 24 attribute octets and preserves AS_PATH tail 4200000123 rather than the supplied AS4_PATH tail 4200000000; no-as4aggregator requires exactly 35 attribute octets, preserves AGGREGATOR AS 4200000123 and excludes the supplied AS4_AGGREGATOR naming 4200000000. Each exact full frame also requires delivery of the route. The OLD-speaker negative carrier requires the actual relayed two-octet AS_PATH [65000,65001,AS_TRANS] and four-octet AS4_PATH [65000,65001,4200000123], distinguishing the destination-scoped prohibition from blanket suppression; it is not an independent negative for AS4_AGGREGATOR. Current receive validation prepares AS4FamilyPlan, session_read consumes its WriteTo result before publication, and WriteTo explicitly omits types 17 and 18 while copying unrelated attributes and NLRI. The corrected comment names that actual path. Current WriteTo halt records in job-final-functional-citations-and-precise-framing-8381327b.log prove reachability only, since replay/EOR can fail before byte comparison; the older CollapseAS4Family-wrapper halt is not semantic evidence for these fixtures. The combined origination and exact relay assertions support both named attributes without treating either single carrier or a halt as proof of the whole clause.
